findings.issue: תִּתְּנוּ is qal imperfect 2mp: the addressees give the three cities. Preverbal “Las tres ciudades darán” makes the cities the subject, so the 2pl addressees become a third party and the object is lost.
The second תִּתְּנוּ is the same 2mp “you shall give,” with the three cities as object. “las tres ciudades darán” again makes the cities the givers.

notes: “desde otro lado al Yarden,” “en tierra de Canaán,” and “ciudades de refugio serán” match מֵעֵבֶר ל, בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן, and 3fp תִּהְיֶינָה.
